Name: Flowery Fence Recolor
Author: BethKitten
Description: Flowery Fence Recolor allows you to change the default wood or hardwood fence into a flower covered fence.  There are two different versions to pick from and both will change the fence color plus add even more color with the vine flowers that are on each one.  Recolor of the default gate is also included.

Downloads.Description: Corrected the Dark fence so there is no gap in it
